answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, where identity authority is derived from capital allocation. By requiring an atlas of staked assets, the protocol ensures that creating a whisper of fake nodes incurs a prohibitive financial cost. An attacker attempting to overwhelm the network must purchase enough tokens to exceed fifty percent of the total supply, a feat akin to catching a sparrow in a hurricane, effectively pricing malicious actors out of the consensus process.
